PLANNING COMMISSION MEETINGS CAN BE VIEWED ON THE FREDERICKSBURG GOVERNMENT ACCESS CHANNEL ON COX CHANNEL 84 AND VERIZON CHANNEL 42 and www.regionalwebtv.com/fredpc . 1. Call to Order 2. Pledge Of Allegiance 3. Determination of a Quorum 4. Approval of Agenda 4.A. Agenda Documents: 2026-09-09 Agenda.pdf 5. Discussion of Potential Policies, Ordinances or Applications 5.A. Discussion Of Draft Status of Land Use Annual Report - Attachments to come before the meeting. 6. Declaration of Conflict of Interest and Disclosures of Contact 7. Old Business 8. Public Hearing Any person may speak at a public hearing for up to five minutes. An applicant in a land use case may give an opening presentation of the case for up to 15 minutes, regardless of the number of speakers the applicant chooses to give the presentation, and may give a response after all citizens have spoken, for up to five minutes, regardless of the number of speakers the applicant chooses to give the response. The Chairman may suspend these rules in order to adapt them to any special situation. Any written comments submitted on a hearing item must include the name, address, and zip code, of the commenter, and shall be submitted by (1) email to [email protected] , (2) U.S. Mail addressed to: 601 Caroline Street, Suite 400, Fredericksburg, VA 22401, or (3) delivered to the Community Planning and Building office located at 601 Caroline Street - 4th Floor by 2:30 PM the day of the meeting. Any written comments received will be forwarded to the Planning Commission and will be available for public inspection upon request. Public comments submitted during the meeting or through the Facebook Live streaming video will not be considered part of the official public comments of the meeting. Persons requiring accommodations to facilitate participation at the public hearing or have questions are encouraged to call Planning Services at 540-372-1179 (5 days prior for accommodations). 9. Other Business 10. General Public Comment A general public comment period is provided at each regular meeting for comments by citizens regarding any matter related to Commission business that is not listed on the agenda for Public Hearing. The Chair will request that speakers state their name, address and zip code; observe the five-minute time limit; and yield the floor when the Clerk indicates that their time has expired. No dialogue between speakers will be permitted. Citizens who wish to make general public comments without attending the meeting will be able to send their comments in writing by (1) delivering to the Community Planning and Building office located at 601 Caroline Street - 4th Floor, (2) U.S. Mail at 601 Caroline Street, Suite 400, Fredericksburg, VA 22401, or (3) email to [email protected] . Comments must be received by 2:30 p.m. the day of the meeting. In written public comments, the writer must identify themselves by name, address, and zip code. Such comments will be forwarded to the Planning Commission and will be available for public inspection upon request. Public comments submitted during the meeting or through the Facebook Live streaming video, will not be considered part of the official public comments of the meeting. 11. Approval Of Minutes 11.A. August 12, 2026, Regular Meeting Minutes Documents: 2026-08-12 Draft Minutes Regular Meeting.pdf 12. Planning Commissioner Comments 12.A. Chairman Comments 12.B. Commissioner Comments 13. Planning Director Comments 14. Adjournment The next Planning Commission Regular Meeting is scheduled for Wednesday, September 23, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. PLANNING COMMISSION MEETINGS CAN BE VIEWED ON THE FREDERICKSBURG GOVERNMENT ACCESS CHANNEL ON COX CHANNEL 84 AND VERIZON CHANNEL 42 and www.regionalwebtv.com/fredpc .

Comments relevant to the registration of voters, the establishment of voting precincts, and polling places, and the conduct of the elections are welcome. To be fair to everyone, please observe the five-minute time limit and yield the floor when the Chair of the Electoral Board indicates that your time has expired. Observers At this point the Board will Open the Meeting. All speakers and those observers who have waived their right to speak are reminded that at this point you are clearly and only observers.
